roleTitle: Staff Development and Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD, as a Staff Development and Infection Control Nurse (RN). This vital role combines your expertise in staff education and infection prevention to ensure the highest standards of care and safety for both residents and staff. You will play a crucial part in fostering a culture of continuous learning and adherence to best practices.

In this dynamic position, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive training programs for nursing staff, as well as overseeing the facility's infection control initiatives. Your contributions will directly impact the quality of care provided and the overall well-being of the community. We are seeking a proactive and knowledgeable RN passionate about education and patient safety.

This full-time opportunity offers a competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00. If you are ready to make a significant impact in a supportive environment, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development, education, or training within a healthcare setting
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal regulations related to infection control and staff education
Strong communication and organizational skills

description:
Are you a dedicated Licensed Practical Nurse looking for a consistent weekend schedule? A premier skilled nursing facility in Gulfport, MS, is seeking a Baylor LPN to join their compassionate team. This is a full-time position, not PRN, and candidates must be committed to the weekend Baylor schedule.

In this vital role, you will provide high-quality nursing care to residents, ensuring their comfort and well-being. While typical LPN shifts are 8 hours, this Baylor position offers extended 12-hour shifts on the weekends, allowing for focused care and continuity. We are looking for an LPN who is passionate about making a difference in the lives of others and thrives in a supportive environment.
requirements: Current and valid Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) license in Mississippi.
Commitment to working consistent Saturday and Sunday, 12-hour Baylor shifts.
Experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting preferred.
Strong clinical assessment and documentation skills.
Ability to provide compassionate and effective patient care.

description:

description:
